scope: Only qid/patient IDs, existing family labels, split/exposure metadata and input construction code. No unseen question/reference/SQL contents accessed for selection; no split created, scored or run.
important_distinction: The 59-patient held_out pool is not 59 untouched patients: its 300 sampled questions expose58. The six dev-pool patients omitted from sampled dev50 are already explicitly documented prior exposures. 94 minus58 is an invalid pristine count.

roles.fixed_300: Adaptive architecture-selection/development validation. Preserve paired first-attempt comparisons and generic failure diagnosis, but stop calling it final held-out generalization evidence.
roles.existing_dev_50_and_pilot_20: Implementation/interface and generic method development on reserved patients. Existing prior-exposure32 dev patients remain development even if absent from sampled50.
roles.nominal_remaining_one_patient: If historical metadata confirms no exposure, retain all18 questions (16 in scope) as a small untouched patient-disjoint diagnostic only. One patient cannot support an independent population generalization estimate or patient-cluster bootstrap interval.
roles.final_2931: One frozen first-attempt complete-release benchmark after selection, report overall and predeclared in-scope2472/out-of-scope459 and exposure strata. It overlaps every development pool and cannot be described as a wholly untouched patient-generalization test.

recommendation: A statistically meaningful untouched patient-disjoint confirmation set cannot be recovered by reshuffling this94-patient release. Obtain additional independent patients/dataset for that claim. Within current data, distinguish a once-only question-disjoint confirmation on uninspected remaining questions from patient-disjoint confirmation; it is the former even on new question IDs.
leakage_controls: Do not reclaim unused question IDs from exposed patients as untouched patients.

Before inspecting any new outputs, freeze candidate and fresh single controls, provider/source/profile hashes, exact patient/qid manifest, family strata, first-attempt policy and acceptance/statistical analysis.
Select only from IDs/patient/family metadata; do not use references, SQL, answer-kind labels, outcomes or model-visible patient values for sampling.
Separate blind run storage from development analysis. No partial scoring or per-case inspection; run both complete paired arms before unsealing once.
If confirmation informs a prompt, method, threshold or selection choice, relabel it development immediately; no optional rerun with replacements.
An automated availability/hash-only preflight does not by itself show answer/model exposure, but cannot prove no undocumented human/model access. Base-model pretraining contamination is unmeasured.

Agent input construction uses question+patientFHIRID+assumption only; source true_answer/SQL are not added to the model request by curate_input_dataset. Keep inference stages unable to load scorer/references.

historical_output_crosscheck.candidate_full_patient_preflight: Availability/packet checks0modelcalls; candidate included. Not pristine from all data-access, but no recorded project QA/model/answer exposure.
limits: Copied archived outputs contribute duplicate attempted rows; unique qid/patient unions remove duplication.

This metadata-only scan covers extant standard result files with run identities under output, .local-setup, and original benchmark snapshot; untracked external temporary runs, deleted logs, or undocumented manual inspection cannot be ruled out.
The sole nominal patient candidate was FHIR-availability checked and packet-prepared; it cannot be called untouched under an any-data-access definition.
Questions remaining for already-exposed patients are question-disjoint only, not patient-disjoint confirmation.

remaining_question_disjoint_confirmation.status: Candidate pool only; no random subset created or scored
remaining_question_disjoint_confirmation.patient_scope: 58 patients already exposed by adaptive300 plus1 outcome-unexposed availability-preflight patient; not a new patient-disjoint confirmation cohort

original_metadata_splits.interpretation: Original labels are not patient-disjoint; originaltest is not an untouched patient cohort.

portability_design_goal: Use model-neutral artifact/witness interfaces and general operators; predeclare later independent model/QA benchmarks separately. No cross-model or external-QA result follows from current FHIR subset.
